metamorphic_relations.name: Enemy body or head launched after kill
metamorphic_relations.check: After a killing blow, is the enemy's body or severed head catapulted unnaturally into the sky or flung with extreme ragdoll force far beyond what the attack would realistically cause?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character floating in air
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a character hovering in mid-air in a seated, standing, or falling pose but their position is not actually changing? They appear stuck or suspended with no ground contact and no downward movement.

metamorphic_relations.name: Horse or animal slides without leg animation
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a horse or animal gliding across the ground sideways or forward with completely static legs — no walking, trotting, or running animation playing while the model moves?

metamorphic_relations.name: Monster frozen or twitching in place
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a monster or creature completely frozen in its idle pose while the player moves freely, or is it twitching, jerking, and sliding without playing a proper movement or attack animation?

metamorphic_relations.name: Character clips through closed door or wall
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a character walk straight through a closed door or solid wall without opening it or breaking it?

metamorphic_relations.name: Missing body part or T-pose
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC's head or body part completely invisible or not rendered, or is an NPC frozen in a T-pose instead of their normal idle animation?

metamorphic_relations.name: Boat flips or spins uncontrollably
metamorphic_relations.check: Does a small boat suddenly flip upside down or spin rapidly in calm water without impact?

metamorphic_relations.name: NPC walks without moving legs
metamorphic_relations.check: Is an NPC visibly moving forward while their legs remain completely still in idle stance?

metamorphic_relations.name: Enemy stuck half underground
metamorphic_relations.check: Is a monster or enemy partially submerged in the ground, with legs or torso visibly inside terrain while still alive or attacking?

metamorphic_relations.name: Dead body bends unnaturally
metamorphic_relations.check: After death, does an enemy's body twist into an impossible shape with limbs sharply bent backward or stretched unnaturally?
